description: This file defines the PHP class 'Image_Graph_Plotarea_Radar', which extends 'Image_Graph_Plotarea' and is responsible for rendering radar plot areas within a graphing library. It includes methods for calculating plot dimensions, boundaries, and coordinate transformations specific to radar charts.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Radar
classes.description: A class representing the plot area for radar charts, handling layout calculations and coordinate transformations specific to radar visualizations.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Radar
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the radar plot area, setting padding, axes, and their relationships.

methods.name: _plotWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of the plot area excluding padding and axes, as 80% of the minimum of height and width.

methods.name: _plotHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the plot area similarly to _plotWidth.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Returns the left boundary coordinate for the background fill area.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Returns the top boundary coordinate for the background fill area.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Returns the right boundary coordinate for the background fill area.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom boundary coordinate for the background fill area.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Converts a data value with X and Y components into a pixel position along the X axis in the plot, considering radial distances.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Converts a data value with X and Y components into a pixel position along the Y axis in the plot.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the element coordinates within the plot area, recalculating axes and layout based on contained elements.
